mechanism: Timolol ophthalmic can be systemically absorbed and may mask hypoglycemic symptoms (tremor, tachycardia) and potentiate insulin's glucose-lowering effects, increasing hypoglycemia risk.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely in diabetic patients using timolol ophthalmic; educate on non-adrenergic hypoglycemia signs (confusion, sweating); consider alternative ophthalmic agents if hypoglycemia episodes occur.
